title: Fulfillment Event
description: Append-only event representing a fact in physical fulfillment. References line items and quantities by ID.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this fulfillment event occurred.

type.description: Open fulfillment event type. Well-known values: processing (preparing goods before carrier or delivery-network handoff), shipped (goods have left the Business's control, normally through handoff; no movement scan required), in_transit (carrier or delivery network has confirmed movement), delivered (delivered to the buyer or agreed location), canceled (this fulfillment flow was canceled and is not expected to complete; not necessarily the entire Order). Businesses MUST use the corresponding well-known value when its semantics match. Businesses MAY use additional values for other semantics, with a non-empty, consumer-understandable description.

quantity.description: Integer count of steps of the referenced line item's `quantity_unit` (`10^-scale` × `unit`); when `quantity_unit` is absent, it counts whole items (`each`).

line_items.description: Line items and quantities to which this fulfillment fact applies. Multiple events can describe successive stages for the same quantities; event quantities MUST NOT be summed to derive the line item's fulfilled quantity.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number (required if type != processing).

tracking_url.description: URL to track this shipment (required if type != processing).

description.description: Consumer-understandable description of the fulfillment event (e.g., 'Delivered to front door'). MUST be present and non-empty for a type outside the well-known values. Optional for well-known values; additional context MUST NOT change their normative meaning. Platforms MUST use this description as the consumer-facing fallback when presenting an unknown type and treat it as untrusted Business-provided text.
